note: Typical reference values. The team must review and justify them (for example, timing on the video how long a motorcycle or a car takes to cover a known stretch).

roundabout.parallel_entry_delay_note: A motorcycle entering next to a car goes in this many seconds after it: [most aggressive, least aggressive]. Calibrated with the Conector headways (15th percentile 0.7 s).
roundabout.lane_choice_note: Two-lane approaches: trips shorter than this share of the ring keep right (outer ring lane), longer ones keep left (inner lane); in between, drivers join the lane with fewer vehicles.

officer.groups_note: Optional. Example: "groups": { "la_lucha": [["north","south"],["east","west"]] } if the officer lets two opposite approaches go at the same time.

simulation.divert_note: A driver who arrives and sees a queue that would take longer than this to get through takes another route (counted as diverted). null = nobody diverts.
